name: SikOgami MCP
description: SikOgami Model Context Protocol server — tools for origami verification and progress. Use Streamable HTTP transport.

tools.name: verifyOrigami
tools.description: Verify a folded paper photo for a level (SikOgami). Input: image base64, levelId 1-30, levelTitle.

tools.name: getProgress
tools.description: Get SikOgami level progress for an email.

tools.name: listLevels
tools.description: List all 30 SikOgami levels with world, sheets, emoji.
